# End card held with a freeze frame

The last nine seconds of the launch film before its fade, with mgvideo freeze holding the end card for three more seconds so the call to action stays on screen; a small label marks the frozen stretch.

- Type: Freeze frame
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `freeze`
- Output: 1920x1080, 12 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f15-freeze-end.mp4`](../videos/f15-freeze-end.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> The end card of ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 is on screen too briefly. Take 4 s to 13 s (before the fade to black) and hold the last frame for 3 more seconds with silent audio padding, so the clip ends on "Say hello at magnifito.com". Mark the held part with a small "Freeze: end frame held 3 s" label in Geist (labels.svg, fonts/) that fades in when the freeze starts.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f15-freeze-end
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f15-freeze-end/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 4 -t 9 -i ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo freeze work/source.mp4 --position end --duration 3 --out work/held.mp4
node rasterize.mjs labels.svg work/labels.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/held.mp4 -loop 1 -t 12 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[1:v]format=rgba,fade=t=in:st=9:d=0.3:alpha=1[lab];[0:v][lab]overlay=0:0:shortest=1,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/final.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/final.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
